scope: Diagnostic original/reverse/original evidence, not production or panel acceptance

verification.programInstanceScope: Each round uses a fresh process. Archived B shader source equality does not mean the same GL program instance.
verification.quadVertexRequirement: A submitted bytes stay fixed; original B equals A, reverse B is exactly four complete stride records reversed.
verification.oracleUVRequirement: use_a remains 0; B uses its original varying UV. UV changes remain measured differences.
verification.scope: One diagnostic triplet with fixed archived shader source bytes. Media identity uses the historical full-byte SHA receipt plus current per-round file size, not a fresh whole-media hash. B RGB/pre/YUV remain measured differences, not accepted equivalence. Producer barriers/uniform assertions are not independent hardware synchronization proof; no panel or compiler root cause claim.
